name: What To Do When You Get Message
overview: When receiving a message, Scripture encourages believers to respond with strength and courage, trusting that God is always present and will not abandon them. The promises found in Deuteronomy 31:6 and Joshua 1:9 assure us that God goes before us, enabling us to face challenges without fear. Trusting wholly in the Lord rather than our own understanding (Proverbs 3:5) and relying on His strength (Psalm 73:26; Isaiah 40:31) empowers us to endure and persevere. God's presence brings help and upholding power, as emphasized in Isaiah 41:10, providing confidence to act faithfully upon the message received.
